---
title: "An Australian as Fed Chair?"
date: "2005-09-01"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

If a job’s worth doing, get an Australian to do it.  [Terry McCrann](http://finance.news.com.au/story/0,10166,16444304-521,00.html "Terry McCrann") makes the case for RBA Governor Macfarlane to become the next Fed Chair.  Now we know why Macfarlane wanted his term extended only three years!
